tiles.title: Design system — Soft rounded
tiles.hero:
Made gently

Soft shapes,
warm welcome.

Plum, peach and sage. Round corners, pill buttons, slow easing.

GiftsBookingsWishlists
tiles.text:
## Principles

- Soft edges, firm words: shapes are round, text stays dark.
- Pastel fills, deep text: tints fill, deep colors speak.
- Unhurried: things ease in slowly and never bounce.

## Starter profile

- **Fits:** lifestyle, beauty, gifting, florists, small shops, parenting. Not for finance, developer tools.
- **Mood:** warm, calm; density airy; shape pill; contrast standard; light first.
- **Type:** Quicksand, Nunito Sans, ui-monospace.
- **Adapt first:** primary, secondary, accent, link. **Keep:** radius-lg, radius-full, foreground.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colors, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each color shows its light and dark values and is checked against the color it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by color alone.
